user_provided_notes: Primary product: JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ, PyCharm). Want tight UX — inline completions + side-panel code-search.
Key ask: local indexing on dev machines or a small shared index server (customer prefers index staying in their VPC).
Latency target: 30-80ms inline completion for single-line suggestions; streaming low-latency for longer completions (sub-200ms token streaming).
POC scope: 50 dev seats, languages: Java, Kotlin, Python. Measure: acceptance rate, completion latency, token cost per completion.
Model strategy: prefer model/version pinning. Want stable pinned model for GA with automated rollbacks. Also curious about quantized variants for local/offline caches.
Offline mode: when no network, use small local fallback model + local index for completions. Progressively degrade suggestions but keep IDE experience usable.
Security: must integrate with company SSO (SAML), audit logging for developer actions, 90-day retention configurable, keys via customer KMS.
Routing/fallback: prefer hosted for lowest latency, fallback to dedicated in same region, then local cached model when network constrained.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade some cost for latency but want token-level cost reports per route and per team.
"We need deterministic rollouts — a bad model update broke internal builds last year" — Director of Dev Tools.
Plugin distribution: plan to publish on JetBrains marketplace but need private rollout channels for early adopters (beta channel).
Integration notes: prefer websocket streaming for completions (SSE ok), incremental index updates, content-aware caching (prefix/KV).
POC success criteria: median inline latency <80ms, 80% of completions judged useful by devs, no P0 security items outstanding.
